xgrids.focus: SLAM capture hardware and large-scene reconstruction
xgrids.edge: Measured LiDAR structure and camera tracking stabilize capture-to-splat workflows.
xgrids.summary: Builds portable scanners and reconstruction software that fuse LiDAR, motion tracking and imagery into point clouds and Gaussian-splat scenes.

volinga.edge: Makes captured radiance fields usable in color-managed film and industrial workflows.
volinga.summary: Turns captures and splat files into editable assets for color-managed production rendering and interactive Unreal Engine scenes.

jawset.edge: An inspectable local tracking, training and editing workflow for captured radiance fields.
jawset.summary: Makes Postshot, a desktop application for local radiance-field reconstruction from photos or video and professional rendering handoffs.

playcanvas.focus: Open web editing, compression and delivery
playcanvas.edge: Open renderer, editor and formats make captured spaces distributable and hackable.
playcanvas.summary: Develops an open web engine and SuperSplat tools for editing, compressing, publishing and embedding Gaussian-splat scenes.

gracia.edge: Turns synchronized captures into view-controllable moving scenes for web and XR.
gracia.summary: Builds capture-to-playback tools for dynamic Gaussian-splat video, letting viewers move around recorded performances.
